rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a recognizable manner of expression, creation, or personal performance.

example.english: Their writing style is refreshingly fresh.
example.traditional: 佢寫文章嘅風格好清新。

rows.note: Use this for the design or fashion style of clothing, hair, accessories, or similar personal presentation.
